Vienna has been selected to host the 70th Eurovision Song Contest in May 2026. The Grand Final will be held on Saturday 16 May at the Wiener Stadthalle, with Semi-Finals on Tuesday 12 May and Thursday 14 May. This will be Vienna's third time hosting Eurovision, after hosting in 1967 and 2015.

Based on the search results, **Vienna has been selected to host Eurovision 2026**.

The announcement was made on August 20, 2025 (before the market closed on September 8, 2025). Vienna will host the 70th Eurovision Song Contest in May 2026, with the Grand Final on Saturday, May 16, 2026, at the Wiener Stadthalle, and Semi-Finals on May 12 and May 14.

Since the resolution criteria state "If Vienna hosts Eurovision 2026, then the market resolves to Yes," and Vienna has indeed been announced as the host city:

**Resolution: YES**
